args.final_thought:
Implemented PatchPad in `/app`.

Highlights:
- Custom virtualized canvas editor—no `textarea`, `contenteditable`, or editor library.
- Keyboard/mouse selection, word/line/full-document selection, scrolling selection, clipboard, undo/redo, and multi-caret editing.
- Visible Save, Undo, Redo, Find Next, Replace Current, Replace All, revision history, line numbers, cursor position, revision, and dirty/saved status.
- SQLite persistence with idempotent seed initialization and preserved generation metadata/tail sentinel.
- Transactional, server-enforced stale revision, unknown ID, mismatched ID, and malformed-save protection.
- Revision preview and restore-as-unsaved-draft behavior.
- `APP_MANIFEST.md`, `npm start`, and automated tests included.

Verification:
- `npm test`: 7/7 tests pass.
- JavaScript syntax checks pass.
- Restart check confirms exactly one seeded document and one initial revision.
- Confirmed no prohibited editing surfaces.

Run with:
```bash
cd /app
npm start
```
Then open `http://localhost:3000`.
